risingCost.what: Microsoft's 1 July 2026 update raised Microsoft 365 plan prices — from 5% (Microsoft 365 E5, US$57 to US$60) to 33% (Microsoft 365 F1, US$2.25 to US$3.00). Microsoft 365 Copilot is not among the plans in that price table: the Copilot seat on this page is Microsoft's current UK list price.
risingCost.note: Both sides keep their Microsoft 365 plans, so this rise is in neither total. It is evidence that the corporate bill rises; the model inflates the corporate lines by CPI, not by this rise.

saasRise.what: Salesforce raised list prices for its Enterprise and Unlimited editions of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service and select Industries Clouds by an average of 6% on 1 August 2025; Starter and Pro editions were not changed.
saasRise.quote: On August 1, 2025, list prices will increase by an average of 6%.
